_comment: Reference values for cp2k-basis-convergence (CP2K 2024.1, PBE, methanol single points with SZV/DZVP/TZVP-MOLOPT-GTH). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: 5 oracle runs per basis produced identical values (spreads: SZV 0, DZVP 8e-15, TZVP 2e-14 Ha; deterministic). Energies decrease monotonically (SZV > DZVP > TZVP by 0.107 and 0.00106 Ha). Tolerances 1e-6 Ha. Cross-verify: verifier re-runs the SZV point on the pinned asset geometry; deterministic to ~1e-14, tol 1e-6.
